title: 第13章 初尝魔法！

content_zh:
山丘亭子，紫色不可思议的能量在一闪而逝的耀眼与绚丽后迅速的消失。
空气里，弥漫着一股焦的味道。
周围的植物，出现了黑状。
地板上，躺着两个人，还在剧烈的抽搐，那模样惨不忍赌，哪里还有刚才不可一世的广池一霸的模样。
另外三个人，已经吓得失常。
“大……莫……莫凡大哥……看在，看在我们也是一片区长大得份上……长大的份上，就……就饶……就饶我们一命吧，我们……我们再也，再也不敢了！！”烟男已经吓得魂都没有了，在他眼里眼前这个十六岁的少年简直比噩梦里的魔鬼还要可怕！
“您……您是尊贵的法师……就，就不要和我们这群人渣一般见识，求您了，不要，不要对我们出手。”牛仔裤男子声音发抖的说道。
看看徐兵和肌肉男那样子，太恐怖了！
牛仔男可不想变成那样！
那一股子怒火，伴随着这雷印的彻底释放也在莫凡的心底终于慢慢的平息下去。
看了一眼惨得不能再惨的徐兵和肌肉男，再看了一眼吓傻了的另外三人。
“送他们去医院吧。”莫凡气平了下来。
事实上，连莫凡也没有想到雷系初阶技能-雷印的威力竟然有这么大！
这应该是自己真真切切的第一次完整释放吧，倘若自己掌握得再熟练一点，准头在控制好一些，并且在释放的时候没有那么一丝犹豫散了力量，恐怕这一掌雷印下去，直接就把站在一起的这五个人全部给轰死了！
也还好，没有出人命。
不然事情真就闹大了！
“是，是，是，我们这就滚，我们这就滚！！”牛仔男看到这位年轻的法师怒气消了，简直跟获得新生一般。
另外两个人也不敢多想，急急忙忙扶着两个在地上已经瘫痪的人……
结果刚触碰，残余的电弧窜入他们手臂，吓得他们一阵哆嗦。
“叫救护车吧。医药费你们自己解决。”莫凡冷冷的说道。

“这就叫，这就叫。”
莫凡气已经消了，事实上心头还有一阵难以掩盖的狂热。
但自己现在就是一个杀神的做派，怎么可以在这几个傻叼面前流露出自己那欣喜若狂的样子。
走到了亭子里，莫凡将那些牌从轮椅垫上扫去，扛起轮椅便顺着阶梯往下走去。
那三人还在心有余悸的看着莫凡。
忽然，莫凡一个转身。
三人吓得急急忙忙后退。
“对了，有人问起来，就说是他们自己偷电出的事。我是法师的事情，你们要是敢传出去，我就叫你们这辈子永远闭嘴。反正我听说警察也不怎么为难得了失手杀人的法师，尤其是自己找死的去挑衅魔法师的社会败类。”莫凡想起了什么，回头叮嘱了这几个人一句。
那三人点头如捣蒜，听话得不能再听话。
“赵坤三和慕白那里，我想以你们的智商不会不知道怎么说话吧？”莫凡潇洒走人。
“我们……我们没蹲到你。”
“行，算你聪明，这次的事情，算过了，以后要是有什么事情，可以来找我，我的能耐，你们见过了。”
“是，是，是，莫凡大哥，慢走，您慢走。”三个人点头哈腰、又敬又怕。
莫凡点了点头，扛着轮椅潇洒走人。
先狠狠的给这般孙子一棒，再稍微给他们一点甜头，莫凡相信这几个家伙已经不敢造次，更不敢把这件事情透露出去一点半点。
这边，他魔法是一个已经可以释放技能的雷系法师，那边一个还在学徒级别的冰系慕白，相信这几个家伙有点脑子都明白该怎么站队！
不过，莫凡也清楚，这五个人只不过是慕白和赵坤三的马前卒。
到时候，还是要这两个鸟蛋好看！
顺着石阶往下走，莫凡终于忍不住仰天大笑了起来！！
几个月前，自己还不过是一个在教室里，会因为历史课的无聊枯燥而望着窗外的普通学生，偶尔也会幻想过自己忽然迎着一阵风飞扬而起，脚轻轻的在旗杆上轻轻的一踏，翱翔到学校后山与蓝天接壤的远方；也幻想过遇到非常让自己愤怒的地痞流氓，在他们靠着凶神恶煞和人多欺凌的时候手掌能够凝聚出一股特殊的力量直接将他们击垮。

谁能想到，自己今天亲自品尝了这种滋味！
手握雷电之力，五名往常自己根本招惹不了的地痞在自己面前跟5条丧家犬一样，这真的是前所未有的奇妙感觉，就像做梦！

content_en:
In the hill pavilion, the incredible energy of purple disappeared quickly after a flash of dazzling and splendor.
There was a burning smell in the air.
The surrounding plants appeared black.
There were two people lying on the floor, still twitching violently. They looked so miserable that they didn't look like the arrogant Hirochi Ichiba just now.
The other three people were already frightened beyond belief.
"Big...Mo...Brother Mo Fan...for the sake of the fact that we grew up in the same area...just...just spare our lives, we...we don't dare to do it anymore!!" Yan Nan was scared to death. In his eyes, the sixteen-year-old boy in front of him was scarier than the devil in nightmares!
"You...you are a distinguished mage...just don't be like scum like us. Please, don't, don't take action against us." The man in jeans said with a trembling voice.
Look at Xu Bing and the muscular man, it’s so scary!
Cowboy men don’t want to be like that!
The anger, accompanied by the complete release of the thunder seal, finally slowly calmed down in Mo Fan's heart.
He glanced at Xu Bing and the muscular man who were miserable, and then at the other three who were stunned.
"Send them to the hospital." Mo Fan calmed down.
In fact, even Mo Fan didn't expect the power of the primary thunder skill - Thunder Seal, to be so powerful!
This should be my first complete release. If I were more proficient in mastering it, could control my accuracy better, and didn't hesitate at all when releasing, I'm afraid that this palm strike would have directly killed all five people standing together!
Fortunately, no one was killed.
Otherwise things will really get into trouble!
"Yes, yes, yes, let's get out of here, let's get out of here!!" The cowboy man saw that the young mage's anger had subsided, as if he had been given a new life.
The other two people didn't dare to think too much and hurriedly supported the two paralyzed people on the ground...
As soon as they touched it, the remaining arcs shot into their arms, making them tremble.
"Call an ambulance. You can pay for the medical expenses yourself." Mo Fan said coldly.
"That's what it's called, that's what it's called."
Mo Fan's anger has subsided. In fact, there is still a wave of fanaticism in his heart that cannot be concealed.
But now that he is a murderer, how can he show his ecstatic look in front of these idiots?
When he reached the pavilion, Mo Fan swept the cards away from the wheelchair mat, picked up the wheelchair and walked down the stairs.
The three people were still looking at Mo Fan with lingering fear.
Suddenly, Mo Fan turned around.
The three of them were so frightened that they hurriedly backed away.
"By the way, when someone asked, they said they stole the electricity themselves. If you dare to spread the news about me being a mage, I will tell you to shut up forever. Anyway, I heard that the police don't care much about mages who accidentally kill people, especially social scum who seek death by provoking magicians." Mo Fan thought of something and turned around to tell these people.
The three people nodded like mincing words, and couldn't be more obedient.
"Zhao Kunsan and Mubai, I don't think you know how to talk with your IQs, right?" Mo Fan left calmly.
"We...we didn't reach you."
"Okay, you're smart. Let's take care of what happened this time. If anything happens in the future, you can come to me. You've seen what I'm capable of."
"Yes, yes, yes, brother Mo Fan, walk slowly, you walk slowly." The three people nodded and bowed, respectful and fearful.
Mo Fan nodded, carrying the wheelchair and walking away gracefully.
First give such a grandson a hard blow, and then give them a little sweetness. Mo Fan believes that these guys no longer dare to make mistakes, let alone reveal the matter at all.
Here, his magic is aThe thunder mage who can already unleash his skills, and the ice mage over there who is still at the apprentice level, I believe these guys have some brains and know how to take sides!
However, Mo Fan also knew that these five people were just pawns of Mu Bai and Zhao Kunsan.
When the time comes, I still want these two bird eggs to look good!
Walking down the stone steps, Mo Fan finally couldn't help but look up to the sky and laugh! !
A few months ago, I was just an ordinary student in the classroom who would look out the window because of the boring history class. Occasionally, I would fantasize about suddenly flying into the gust of wind, lightly stepping on the flagpole, and soaring to the distance where the mountains behind the school meet the blue sky. I also imagined that I would encounter local gangsters who made me very angry.
Who would have thought that I would personally taste this taste today!
With the power of thunder and lightning in his hands, five gangsters who he could not usually provoke were like five homeless dogs in front of him. This was really an unprecedented and wonderful feeling, just like a dream!
